packageRules.description: Patch bumps are mostly noise for a repo this size. They still show on the dependency dashboard if you want to pull one in manually
...except when the patch is the security fix. Later rules win, so this re-enables exactly that case
Actions are digest-pinned; group the bumps into one PR
The floor here has to stay in step with the homeassistant key in hacs.json, so bump it deliberately rather than automatically
ruff formatting output changes between releases, so keep this in step with required-version in pyproject.toml
